show.description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?
